sheets.weapons: RHAAST goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): the living scythe - the crimson crescent blade with its steel-blue edge and red eye at one end of the long violet-blue shaft, the red spear point at the other - as big as in image 1, held in his hands, raised, swung, thrust or planted as the pale figure holds it. Only him and Rhaast: no shadow mist, no dark trails, no afterimages; the eyes' red stays inside the eyes.
